label_source: 40 curated domain questions grounded in the actual cached schema; the command-history case also uses the user's explicit correction. These are seed relevance labels, not a claim of 40 independently reviewed production queries.

cases.question: Give the history of orders of command CMD-000012897984.
cases.rationale: The user's correction identifies this as the order-processing history source.

cases.question: Show the latest processing status of command CMD-000012897984.
cases.rationale: Latest status is ordered by executionDate in command processing events.

cases.question: Which microservices processed this command and when?
cases.rationale: Command event records include microservice and executionDate.

cases.question: Show current orders with their products, quantities and customer details.
cases.rationale: Current orders embed products, quantities and customerInfo.

cases.question: Count current orders grouped by their order status.
cases.rationale: Order records expose statusOrder.

cases.question: Find historical order records with contract details and an execution end date.
cases.rationale: Historical order payloads include contracts and endExecutionDate.

cases.question: Show service requests with failed retry counts and their initiators.
cases.rationale: Requests expose retryFailed and initiator.

cases.question: Count current service requests grouped by request status.
cases.rationale: Current service requests include requestStatus.

cases.question: Find historical request payloads with transaction identifiers and execution end dates.
cases.rationale: Historical request documents include transactionId and endExecutionDate.

cases.question: Show the processing history for request REQ-123 including platforms and microservices.
cases.rationale: Request processing events expose requestId, platformName and microservice.

cases.question: Count failed request processing events by platform.
cases.rationale: Live request processing events expose status and platformName.

cases.question: Find archived request processing logs for request REQ-123.
cases.rationale: Explicitly archived processing events belong to the archive.

cases.question: Show manual retry records for command CMD-123 with their retry counts.
cases.rationale: Manual recycling records contain command identifiers and retry information.

cases.question: Find archived manual recycle requests with their sent dates.
cases.rationale: The archive contains historical manual recycle records and sentDate.

cases.question: Which shopping cart belongs to command CMD-123?
cases.rationale: The association has both commandId and shoppingCartId; no join is needed.

cases.question: Show cart headers with their creator, creation date and current status.
cases.rationale: Cart metadata is stored in basketHeader.

cases.question: Show the customer's email and billing cycle for shopping cart CART-123.
cases.rationale: Customer contact and billing details are stored with shoppingCartId.

cases.question: Show shopping cart totals before and after tax.
cases.rationale: Trailer totals are totalPriceHT and totalPriceTTC.

cases.question: List basket actions with their product descriptions and priorities.
cases.rationale: Basket actions contain priority and products.productDescription.

cases.question: Find basket sub-actions with dependent CFS details and user actions.
cases.rationale: Sub-action records expose dependent CFS and userAction.

cases.question: Show recurring and one-time product prices with gross, net and discount amounts.
cases.rationale: Product pricing records contain recurring and oneTimeBilling amounts.

cases.question: Show bulk SMS test messages with sender, receiver and delivery status.
cases.rationale: Test messages expose sender, receiver, message and status.

cases.question: Show SMS service requests with their platform job statuses.
cases.rationale: SMS request payloads expose platforms.jobType and platforms.status.

cases.question: Which SMS templates and sending flags apply to the master and slave for an action?
cases.rationale: SMS action configuration contains receivers and message/sendSms values.

cases.question: Show USSD requests with master and slave phone numbers.
cases.rationale: USSD documents expose master and slave MSISDN fields.

cases.question: Map an external offer identifier to its CS offer identifier and type.
cases.rationale: Offer mapping has external and CS offer IDs and types.

cases.question: Find the balance identifier and unit of measure for a product code.
cases.rationale: Product balance configuration exposes productCode, csBalanceId and csBalanceUOM.

cases.question: List HLR service methods with namespaces and execution sequence numbers.
cases.rationale: HLR method configuration includes namespace and seqNo.

cases.question: List IN service method actions and inputs in sequence order.
cases.rationale: IN method configuration includes action, inputs and seqNo.

cases.question: Show active platform input extraction paths by input name.
cases.rationale: This mapping has inputName, platformName and isActive.

cases.question: Show input extraction mappings by action type and method name.
cases.rationale: The action/method mapping exposes actionType and methodsnames.

cases.question: Which consumer and producer topics are configured for a microservice?
cases.rationale: Topic configuration contains microservice, consumerTopic and producerTopic.

cases.question: Show platform and command error bypass rules for a microservice.
cases.rationale: Bypass configuration contains microservices, platformConfig and commands.

cases.question: Show the web service request and method used in a platform simulation.
cases.rationale: Simulation records contain webServiceRequest and methodName.

cases.question: List project names and their prefixes.
cases.rationale: Project metadata includes project_name and prefix.

cases.question: Show the current product numbering counter.
cases.rationale: Product sequence stores an integer counter value.

cases.question: For command CMD-123, find its shopping cart and show that cart's header status and creation date.
cases.rationale: Resolve commandId to shoppingCartId, then read header-only status/date fields.

cases.question: For each cart header, show its status alongside the total price including tax.
cases.rationale: Join header status and trailer totalPriceTTC by shoppingCartId.

cases.question: Show basket action descriptions alongside the corresponding separate recurring price records.
cases.rationale: Join action descriptions to separate pricing via basketActionId.

cases.question: For command CMD-123, find the associated cart and show that cart's customer's billing cycle and email.
cases.rationale: Resolve command/cart association then join cart-specific customerInfo by shoppingCartId.
